goal: Prevent buggy or compromised external signers and bridge software from altering transaction outputs or fees
Reject unsafe sighash flags and finalized inputs, merging returned PSBTs instead of replacing them wholesale
Allow functional tests to simulate and test malicious signer responses using an offline descriptor wallet
reviewability: All reported concerns and suggestions have been addressed with test coverage
agreement: Substantive support with no open objections
Concept approval for hardening signer handling and improving test mocks (jeanpablojp)
Verified rejection of unsafe sighashes, finalized inputs, and corrupted signatures via tests (fametrano)
Resolved objection: finalized PSBTs could bypass unsafe sighash checks, fixed by rejecting them (jeanpablojp)
